notes.title: Update Log #10 – Demo Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468257/2a75322dcee1ca9211fa03f8e1e85d5b4b871cbc.png[/img]

[h1][b]The demo has been updated![/b][/h1]

+ You can now play up to Main Quest 3 in the demo.
+ All 108 playable characters are now available in the demo.
+ You can now upgrade your party’s stats using tickets.
+ The tutorial has been expanded with more explanations.

– Classic Mode has been removed.
– Chaos Mode has been removed.

[u][b]Note: If you have existing save data from a previous demo version, the game may not function properly. It is recommended to reset your save data via the in-game cheat menu.[/b][/u]

[h1][b]What’s next?[/b][/h1]

I’m now preparing free post-launch content updates!

1. New Main Quests
2. New Questers
3. New Skills
4. New Classes
